text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states that the steering committee meets bi-weekly.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s2","quote":"The steering committee meets bi-weekly to review project status, budget utilization, and risk items."}]},{"text":"The Project Overview Document does not state how often the steering committee meets; it mentions only a quarterly review by the steering committee to track progress against success metrics.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p2-s6","quote":"A quarterly review will be conducted by the steering committee to track progress against these metrics."}]},{"text":"The documents therefore do not give two different meeting frequencies for the steering committee, so no direct disagreement is stated.","kind":"framing","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
